scope: README setup, application operation, and native Windows iCloud replacement guidance
material_decisions: Windows commands use the local virtual-environment interpreter so PowerShell activation policy does not block operation.
WSL may prepare replacement JPEGs and manifests but must not execute the live iCloud replacement script.
The generated native Windows executor processes both prepared and prepared_existing rows, so it reconciles its full manifest rather than only new updates.
The README documents the preview's scope, live-run safety checks, result review, and USB superseded-source ledger step.
validation_performed: Reviewed the replacement implementation and generated PowerShell executor.
Confirmed the prepared manifest contained 485 clean records: 156 prepared and 329 prepared_existing.
Confirmed the native Windows WhatIf preview completed for the full manifest without changing iCloud files.
open_questions: Whether the user intends to execute the full 485-record native Windows replacement manifest remains unresolved.
recommended_next_step: If the full manifest is intended, run the generated PowerShell executor without WhatIf, review native_windows_replacement_results.csv, then seed the native Windows results into the USB superseded-source ledger.
